verdict.rationale: Square's Terminal API documents collecting tips at checkout on the terminal, including a separate tip input screen and custom tip amounts. The evidence does not show configurable tip percentages or smart-amount presets, and it does not cover reader-side tipping or a merchant-ops (non-developer) configuration path. Missing for 10: configurable percentage presets, smart tip amounts, reader/dashboard tip-configuration evidence, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can configure tipping prompts (percentages, smart amounts, custom tips) collected on the reader or terminal

citations.quote: Tip money: Collect tips as money at checkout. Supports showing a separate tip input screen before getting a buyer's signature and allowing custom tip amounts.
